approachQuestion.prompt:
A Letter Addition

Two uppercase words A and B are added to form C. Each distinct letter must map to one decimal digit; different letters have different digits. A multi-letter word cannot start with zero. Return every digit mapping that makes A+B=C numerically true, once. Single-letter words may be zero.

Examples:
A="A",B="A",C="B" -> [{A:1,B:2},{A:2,B:4},{A:3,B:6},{A:4,B:8}].
A="A",B="B",C="A" -> nine mappings with B=0 and A any digit 1..9.

Constraints: 1 <= each word length <= 6; at most 8 distinct letters. Words contain A..Z. Repeated letters always use the same digit.

options.text: Process columns from right to left with a carry. Assign unbound addend letters using unused legal digits and enforce the resulting sum digit immediately before advancing. Restore newly introduced bindings on return.
options.feedback: Column arithmetic determines the result digit and carry. Rejecting a wrong digit now is safe regardless of future columns, and reused letters retain one global assignment.

options.text: Choose digits independently for every letter occurrence, checking only that each column adds correctly.
options.feedback: For A="A", B="A", C="B", different values for the two A occurrences could satisfy a column but violate the single mapping per letter.

options.text: Allow zero for the first letter of any word, including multi-letter words.
options.feedback: For A="AB", B="C", C="DE", mapping A=0,B=9,C=3,D=1,E=2 gives 09+3=12 with distinct digits but has a forbidden leading zero.

options.text: Enumerate all injective legal assignments to all letters, evaluate the three words, and retain assignments satisfying the equation.
options.feedback: This is correct but delays every arithmetic rejection until all letters are assigned; column constraints can prune before unrelated letters receive digits.

feedback.reason: Column arithmetic determines the result digit and carry. Rejecting a wrong digit now is safe regardless of future columns, and reused letters retain one global assignment.
details: Start at the units column with carry zero. Assign any unbound addend letters of this column by trying unused legal digits, reusing bindings for repeats; missing positions contribute zero. Compute the required result digit and outgoing carry. Check or assign the result letter, then recurse to the next column. Undo only bindings introduced at this level. At the end require zero carry and copy the complete mapping.

Units-first addition determines one result digit and carry from current addends. Repeated letters reuse bindings, leading letters reject zero, and undo removes only bindings introduced by this branch. Final carry must be zero.

complexityQuestion.prompt: Analyze `acm-b18-18-search` only. Let L be the sum of word lengths, V count all column and local digit-assignment calls/trials, and R count letter-digit entries copied into output. Pre-scan all words to collect letters and leading restrictions. Use fixed 26-letter mapping arrays and ten used-digit flags; each column contains at most three letters. Missing result positions require sum digit zero. Process through the maximum word length and require zero final carry. Choose the tightest stated time and auxiliary-space pair. Count recursion and mutable working state; exclude supplied input and returned output storage, but include copying work in time. Primitive integer/index operations and preallocated-array updates cost constant time; dynamic appends are amortized constant time. No hashing is used unless explicitly stated.

options.text: O(L + V + R) time, O(L) auxiliary space
O(L + R) time, O(L) auxiliary space
O(L + V + R) time, O(1) auxiliary space
O(L·V + R) time, O(L) auxiliary space

feedback.reason: Count input scanning, digit trials, and copied complete mappings.
details: The initial scan costs L. Each local trial or column step does constant bounded-alphabet/digit work, counted in V. Copying the at most eight assigned entries per result adds R.
Fixed mapping/used arrays and one constant-size frame per processed column or local letter trial use linear stack space in the maximum word length, bounded by L.

Let L be the sum of word lengths, V count all column and local digit-assignment calls/trials, and R count letter-digit entries copied into output. Pre-scan all words to collect letters and leading restrictions. Use fixed 26-letter mapping arrays and ten used-digit flags; each column contains at most three letters. Missing result positions require sum digit zero. Process through the maximum word length and require zero final carry.
“O(L + R) time, O(L) auxiliary space”: Digit assignments can branch repeatedly before a contradiction is found.
“O(L + V + R) time, O(1) auxiliary space”: Column recursion can retain a frame per input column.
“O(L·V + R) time, O(L) auxiliary space”: Column checks use individual letters and carry, not reevaluation of whole words.
